name: hybrid
rationale: M5-04 fallback / attribution candidate (record 113), restated on top of the released retrieval bundle (policy 3361ed13): only the answer-context layout changes, off -> compact-v1 (short aliases instead of the chunk and document UUIDs in every evidence block header; evidence text untouched). On its own it cannot reach the 25% token target (offline projection about a tenth of all model tokens); it exists so that a sentfocus-v1 result can be split into the lossless part and the sentence-selection part if needed. Not evaluated yet.
